note: Key map per platform. {n} is the digit; {key} is the platform's key for that digit. One file, three platforms; tests on each platform read it.

switch.description: Go to workspace n on the display you are on.

move.description: Send the front window to workspace n and follow it.

move_stay.description: Send the front window to workspace n and stay where you are (macOS: no default key; Linux: Omarchy's move-silently keys).

overview.description: See all nine workspaces at once.

agent_toggle.description: Show or hide the agent workspace.

switcher.description: Step through the windows of every workspace, most recently used first; letting go of the modifier goes to the one picked (Shift steps back).

launcher.description: Open the launcher: apps, windows, files, install, web search.

macos.alternates: Setup can swap cmd for ctrl, alt or ctrl+alt.
macos.agent_workspace: workspace 9, when agent mode is on

linux.key_note: {key} is Hyprland's keycode for the digit row: code:10 for 1 through code:18 for 9, the same codes Omarchy uses.
linux.agent_workspace: Hyprland special workspace `special:agent`, not one of 1-9
linux.switcher_note: Alt+Shift+Tab steps back. Omarchy's Alt+Tab (cycle in place) and Super+Space (the Omarchy menu) are replaced; the menu stays on Super+Alt+Space and in the launcher's System list.
linux.overview_note: Super+Tab and Super+Shift+Tab were Omarchy's next and previous workspace. They still are: the overview opens on the next (previous) one, Tab steps, letting go of Super goes there. Super+Ctrl+Tab (the former workspace) is Omarchy's own and untouched.

windows.note: Win+1-9 belongs to the taskbar. Changeable.
